shared_elements: human figure rendered in low relief
horizontal dividing lines or bands across the surface
upright slab-shaped field bearing all the imagery
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief human imagery on an upright slab-like field with a prominent circular disc and horizontal dividing lines, but that is about as generic as figural relief gets. A shows a single frontal, highly schematic anthropomorph whose body is the whole slab, with face, arms, chest disc and belt integrated into the figure and no script; B shows a narrative two-figure scene in strict profile flanking an offering stand, above several registers of small repeated written signs — quite different conventions and relationships.
